scenes.text: Multiplying a fraction by a whole number means several equal fractional groups; use strips to model.
Calculate 5/8 of 48. The answer is 30. One 8th of 48 is 6; multiply by 5 to get 30.
6/8 of 32 reading cards are used at a market stall. How many cards is that? Pause the video and think.
6/8 of 32 reading cards are used at a market stall. How many cards is that? The answer is 24. One 8th of 32 is 4; multiply by 6 to get 24.
